meta.title: Before you go — OpenScreenShot
meta.description: You uninstalled OpenScreenShot. If it worked, a rating helps other people find a private tool. If it failed, tell us what happened.

label: OpenScreenShot
heading: Before you go.
lead: If it worked, a rating is the whole growth engine. If it failed, tell us. We read it.

happy.heading: It worked, I just don't need it.
happy.body: Then a public rating is the highest-leverage thing you can do for an open-source tool. It takes 30 seconds.

broken.heading: Something was wrong.
broken.body: What happened? What did you expect?
broken.placeholder: Example: full page missed the footer on a dashboard. Or: the capture came out blank on a site I use every day.
broken.mailFallback: If your mail app does not open, write to
broken.thanks: Thanks. If you are willing, a rating still helps people who need a private option.
